heading: Anhydrous ammonia

tree.text: It is unlawful for any person— knowing, intending, or having reasonable cause to believe that such anhydrous ammonia will be used to manufacture a controlled substance in violation of this part.

children.text: to transport stolen anhydrous ammonia across State lines,

tree.text: Any person who violates subsection (a) shall be imprisoned or fined, or both, in accordance with section 843(d) of this title as if such violation were a violation of a provision of section 843 of this title.
